paragraphs: Redbrick Opportunity Fund V will capitalize the fourth parcel at the Bridge District (Parcel 2), a planned 625-650 unit multifamily development in Washington, D.C. Located a little over one mile from the U.S. Capitol, this Net-Zero Carbon targeted property is part of a transformative 2.5 million square foot mixed-use neighborhood. Built with a commitment to sustainable construction materials and leading-edge operating systems, the project is designed to significantly reduce carbon emissions, driving tenant demand and compressing exit capitalization rates.

The offering provides investors unique flexibility through two distinct share classes: Class I (Common Equity) for long-term capital appreciation, and Class II (70% Preferred / 30% Common Equity) which offers a 9.0% accruing preferred dividend with upside participation. Furthermore, the Fund's low-leverage construction strategy anticipates returning 35% to 65% of invested capital through a permanent refinancing event at stabilization in years 4 or 5.
summary.conclusion: Redbrick Opportunity Fund V presents a rare build-to-core opportunity to invest in a pioneering, sustainable multifamily development poised to capture Washington, D.C.'s next wave of growth.

paragraphs: Redbrick LMD is a community-minded, vertically integrated real estate developer and Opportunity Zone fund manager with impact at the heart of its business. Founded in 2003, the firm acts as an experienced build-to-core developer of large-scale transformative neighborhoods, specializing in ground-up development in Washington, DC.

Redbrick is a pioneer in the decarbonization of commercial real estate in the United States, utilizing sustainability-sourced construction materials (such as mass timber) and advanced operating systems to target net-zero carbon operations across its portfolio.

teamMembers.name: Thomas Skinner
teamMembers.title: Founder and Managing Partner
teamMembers.background: Tom Skinner has invested in and developed close to $2 billion in real estate assets and established a pipeline of over $8 billion in future development projects. Prior to founding Redbrick, Tom invested in or founded numerous operating businesses, primarily in the real estate, technology, and financial services industries. Tom began his professional career at McKinsey and Co., where he worked with financial institutions on strategy issues. Tom earned his PhD in economics from MIT and his BA in economics from Oxford University.

teamMembers.name: William Passmore
teamMembers.title: Founder and Managing Partner
teamMembers.background: William Passmore has extensive experience in structuring and negotiating joint venture investment partnerships and oversees the Redbrick risk management processes. Prior to joining Redbrick in 2005, William was a partner at McKinsey and Co., where he held a series of leadership positions in the private equity, telecommunications, and marketing practices. He is a graduate of Stanford University Graduate School of Business and Imperial College in London.

teamMembers.name: Louis Dubin
teamMembers.title: Founder and Managing Partner
teamMembers.background: Louis Dubin merged his firm, LMD Worldwide, with Redbrick in 2013. Louis has invested over $2 billion of equity in U.S. based real estate assets, and over $1 billion internationally, with a gross value of approximately $4-5 billion. He has completed over 30 real estate developments and investments. Louis completed his undergraduate work at Washington & Lee University, and his law degree at The Washington College of Law, American University. He was appointed Chair of the NY State Common Retirement Fund Real Estate Committee in 2023 after serving on the Committee for 20 years.
